## 任务：exp-007 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ 4-bit D012 SICA on cuda:0

### 服务器: westd-25068
### GPU: cuda:0
### exp_id: exp-007-qwen72b-awq

### 背景
72B within-family scaling 实验。AWQ 4-bit 量化 (~40-50GB) 可单卡放入 RTX PRO 6000。验证 scaling 是否改善 constraint extraction quality。

### Step 1: 下载 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ
```bash
# 检查是否已有
find /root -name "*72B*AWQ*" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -5
find /root/.cache -name "*72B*" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -5

# 如果没有，从 HuggingFace 下载
pip install huggingface_hub -q
huggingface-cli download Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ --local-dir /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ
```

下载可能要 30-60 分钟（~40GB）。下载完成后继续。

### Step 2: 清理 cuda:0
```bash
nvidia-smi
# kill 所有 cuda:0 上的进程（exp-030 已完成）
ps aux | grep -E "vllm.*8000" | grep -v grep
# kill 旧 vLLM if any
```

### Step 3: 启动 vLLM with AWQ
```bash
export VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ \
  --port 8000 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
  --max-model-len 4096 \
  --quantization awq \
  --enforce-eager &

# 等 vLLM ready（72B 加载可能 3-5 分钟）
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  if curl -s http://localhost:8000/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "72B AWQ vLLM ready"
    break
  fi
  sleep 5
done
```

注意：如果 OOM，尝试降低 gpu-memory-utilization 到 0.90 或 max-model-len 到 2048。

### Step 4: 准备运行脚本
复用 exp-001 的代码 `run_sica_expanded.py`。

```bash
cd /root/autodl-tmp/sica_project
# 查看 pipeline 入口
ls *.py | head -10
cat run_sica_pipeline.py --help 2>/dev/null | head -20
# 或者查看 exp-001/exp-026 用的脚本
ls scripts/run_sica* scripts/run_exp0* 2>/dev/null | head -10
```

创建 `scripts/run_exp007_72b_awq.sh`:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
export VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

cd /root/autodl-tmp/sica_project

# 启动 vLLM
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
  --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ \
  --port 8000 --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 --max-model-len 4096 \
  --quantization awq --enforce-eager &
# 等 ready
for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl -s http://localhost:8000/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 5; done

# D012 = 30 ProofWriter + 30 FOLIO = 60 题
# K=12, T=0.7, T_ext=0.3
python run_sica_pipeline.py \
  --dataset d012 \
  --model-name Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ \
  --api-base http://localhost:8000/v1 \
  --K 12 --temperature 0.7 --temperature-ext 0.3 \
  --output-dir results/exp-007-qwen72b-awq/ \
  2>&1 | tee results/exp-007-qwen72b-awq/run.log

# 清理
pkill -f "vllm.*8000"
```

#!/bin/bash
# exp-007: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ 4-bit, SICA vs SC on D012 (30 PW + 30 FOLIO)
# Server: westd-25068, GPU: cuda:0 (single GPU AWQ)
# K=12, T=0.7, T_ext=0.3 (default), seed=42
set -e

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python
MODEL_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ
PORT=8000
RESULTS_DIR=/root/symb_invariant_consensus/results/exp-007-qwen72b-awq

cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

echo "=== [$(date)] exp-007: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ D012 ==="

# ── Step 1: Download model if not present ──
if [ ! -d "$MODEL_DIR" ] || [ $(find "$MODEL_DIR" -name "*.safetensors" 2>/dev/null | wc -l) -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "=== Downloading Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ (~40GB) ==="
    $PYTHON -c "
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ', local_dir='$MODEL_DIR')
print('DOWNLOAD_DONE')
"
    echo "=== [$(date)] Download complete ==="
else
    echo "Model already exists at $MODEL_DIR"
fi

# ── Step 2: Create D012 subset (30 PW + 30 FOLIO = 60 problems) ──
echo "=== Creating D012 subset ==="
$PYTHON -c "
import json, os
pw = json.load(open('data/proofwriter_full.json'))[:30]
folio = json.load(open('data/folio_full.json'))[:30]
os.makedirs('data', exist_ok=True)
with open('data/pw_d012_30.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(pw, f, indent=2)
with open('data/folio_d012_30.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(folio, f, indent=2)
print(f'D012: {len(pw)} PW + {len(folio)} FOLIO = {len(pw)+len(folio)} problems')
"

# ── Step 3: Check port free ──
if curl -s http://localhost:$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: Port $PORT already in use"
    exit 1
fi

# ── Step 4: Start vLLM with AWQ on cuda:0 ──
echo "=== [$(date)] Starting vLLM (AWQ, single GPU) on port $PORT ==="
export VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

$PYTHON -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model "$MODEL_DIR" \
    --port $PORT \
    --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
    --max-model-len 4096 \
    --quantization awq \
    --enforce-eager \
    > /tmp/vllm_exp007.log 2>&1 &
VLLM_PID=$!
echo "vLLM PID: $VLLM_PID"

echo "Waiting for vLLM ready (72B AWQ load ~3-5 min)..."
READY=0
for i in $(seq 1 180); do
    if curl -s http://localhost:$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "vLLM ready after ${i}s"
        READY=1
        break
    fi
    if ! kill -0 $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "ERROR: vLLM died. Log:"
        tail -40 /tmp/vllm_exp007.log
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 5
done

if [ $READY -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: vLLM did not start in 900s"
    tail -40 /tmp/vllm_exp007.log
    kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
fi

# ── Step 5: Run SICA pipeline ──
echo ""
echo "=== [$(date)] Running SICA pipeline: D012 (60 problems), K=12 ==="
mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR"

PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 $PYTHON -u run_full_mvp.py \
    --mode vllm \
    --k 12 \
    --temperature 0.7 \
    --max-tokens 4096 \
    --api-base "http://localhost:$PORT/v1" \
    --model auto \
    --seed 42 \
    --math-data data/empty.json \
    --pw-data data/pw_d012_30.json \
    --folio-data data/folio_d012_30.json \
    --output "$RESULTS_DIR/exp007_results.json" \
    --save-intermediates \
    --resume \
    2>&1 | tee "$RESULTS_DIR/exp007_run.log"

EXIT_CODE=$?

# ── Step 6: Cleanup ──
echo ""
echo "=== [$(date)] Stopping vLLM ==="
kill $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait $VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true

echo "Results: $RESULTS_DIR/exp007_results.json"
echo "Log: $RESULTS_DIR/exp007_run.log"
echo "vLLM log: /tmp/vllm_exp007.log"
echo "EXIT_CODE=$EXIT_CODE"
echo "EXP007_DONE"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp007_72b_awq.sh
